1.title: Welcome, Cultivator
1.body: Your path to immortality starts here. Click the cultivating character (or press Tab) at any time to open the Command Wheel — the entry point to every part of your dwelling.

2.title: The Cave Dwelling
2.body: Your character cultivates over time, even while you are away. Open Command Wheel → Character to see your realm and cultivation progress.

3.title: Breakthrough
3.body: When your cultivation is ready, the Breakthrough action opens under Character — succeed to raise your realm and cultivation power.

4.title: Armory
4.body: Open Command Wheel → Armory to forge and refine equipment from gathered materials.

5.title: Equipment
5.body: Gear in the Character panel raises combat power — wear your best before heading out.

6.title: Exploration
6.body: The Gathering outpost (Command Wheel → Gathering, or click the building on the map) collects materials over time — return to harvest when it finishes.

7.title: Combat
7.body: Open Command Wheel → Teleport Array (or click the building on the map) to pick a combat realm — your character fights automatically until the battle ends.

8.title: Spoils of Battle
8.body: Defeated beasts drop spirit stones, materials, and sometimes rare equipment.

9.title: Begin
9.body: Everything is ready — may you ascend swiftly, cultivator!
